brief: Converts a stzDiagram or a stzOrgChart to flowchart text for Mermaid once, at construction, and offers that text and a file writer.
detail: The text starts with graph TD; start and end nodes are written as stadium shapes, other nodes as boxes, and an edge label between pipes. A node whose id is start is written as node_start.
receiver: o1 = new stzDiagram("flow"); o1.AddNodeXTT("start", "Order Received", [ :type = "start" ]); o1.AddNodeXT("validate", "Validate"); o1.AddNodeXTT("done", "Done", [ :type = "endpoint" ]); o1.AddEdgeXT("start", "validate", "next"); o1.AddEdge("validate", "done"); o2 = new stzDiagramToMermaid(o1)
